concept: Moving your body every day feels good and helps you grow strong
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.story: A short tale where a character tries different kinds of movement (running, climbing, dancing) and discovers how good it feels to move
exercise.reflection_prompt: Which kind of moving did the character enjoy most, and why?
exercise.practice: Student names a way they like to move their body and does it for a few minutes

assessment.success_marker: student names a genuine, specific movement activity they enjoy
